knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The route is mapped before anything is staged, so that no material blocks an exit.
The obstruction is moved only under the plan, and the route is rechecked before work resumes.
One clear doorway does not finish the job while another exit is blocked.

practicalCriteria: In a training plan, the learner walks the route on a drawing and marks every exit and the meeting point before any material is staged.
The learner identifies a blocked exit in a scenario, stops the affected work and writes the partial-completion record.
passRule: Knowledge checks only: three of three correct is a reading pass. It is not practical competence. Practical sign-off: an assessor observes each practical criterion and records it as met or not met.
evidenceRequired: Knowledge-check result recorded by the assessor
Completed training worksheet or role-play record for the scenario, marked by a trainer
stopWorkCriteria: Any material is staged in an exit route.
An exit is blocked and work continues in the affected area.
